title: IPBES TCA-Nexus approaches-actions linking pipeline
description: R targets pipeline behind the approaches x actions analysis of the IPBES Transformative Change / Nexus article: an OpenAlex corpus over the two IPBES Zotero groups, regex extraction of definition citations, and BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 embeddings, producing the approaches x actions heat map.
